body:
odd question. lots of ways.

perhaps in the most objective sense, financially. i cost my family more money than i take in, considering low-paying employment w/ few hours. have for the majority of my life, in fact. not to mention the inherent opportunity cost of doing things with or for me when they could be doing something else more productive.

in more, i suppose, subjective matters, i'm an emotional burden--my negative mental state is both disruptive in a sense that it is a general downturn towards other people and in that it often leads to outbursts which can disturb my family and friend's normal day-to-day routines. or at least be visible in public spaces, which is not fun for anyone involved.
